subject: Blueprint for POC: success criteria, timeline, and blocker mitigation
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluepeak.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Feb 2027 10:12:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & proposed POC playbook — BluePeak

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can get a kick-off scheduled: 

What we heard
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood inference for BluePeak's customer support summarization pipeline (throughput + accuracy).
- Success criteria (your ask): average 95% reduction in agent time per ticket for summary generation + median 99th percentile latency < 350ms at 8 concurrent users.
- Data constraints: training/eval on-prem datasets (sensitive PII), must meet audit/KMS requirements; prefer VPC/private deployment.

Proposed short POC (3 weeks) — high level
1) Week 0 (kickoff): environment access, security review, and data exchange checklist.
2) Week 1: baseline run on 500 representative tickets — latency + quality evals.
3) Week 2: scale tests (concurrency), regression checks, and UX/SDK integration.
4) Week 3: review, handoff, and next-step commitment discussion.

Ownership
- Redwood lead: Tessa Morgan (sales, POC coordination)
- Solutions lead: Hannah Schmitt (technical onboarding / infra)
- BluePeak lead: Samir Patel (product) and Elena Ruiz (platform/security)

Open items / immediate asks
- Confirmation that BluePeak can provide a 500-ticket sample (sanitized or in a secure SFTP) by Feb 28.
- Indicate whether BluePeak requires private (VPC/on-prem) deployment for the POC.

Attachments: POC playbook draft (attached) and success matrix (spreadsheet).

If that looks good, I’ll send a calendar invite for a 30-minute kickoff and loop in Engineering for the security questionnaire.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0198

Attachment: bluepeak_poc_playbook.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluepeak.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluepeak.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC playbook — BluePeak

Thanks, Tessa — this is helpful and aligned with what we discussed. A few items from our side: 

1) Timeline: Two things — we can get you a 500-ticket sample by Mar 3, not Feb 28. Can the kickoff shift a week?
2) Private deployment: yes, we require VPC-only for this POC due to customer data controls. We will need audit logs, SOC2 evidence, and KMS integration for key management.
3) Success criteria clarification: the 95% reduction target should be evaluated on a stratified sample (priority/high/low tickets). We care about no degradation in classification accuracy > 1% vs. current rule-based approach.

Risks: If we can’t get private deployment within the first week, we can’t proceed — our security team won’t sign off.

Next steps: Can you confirm Redwood's VPC offering and a short list of required network access (CIDRs, ports)? Also share the SOC2 snapshot and typical audit report redactions.

Samir
Samir Patel | Head of Product, BluePeak Systems
samir.patel@bluepeak.com

On Wed, Feb 24, 2027 at 10:12 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> [see above]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Recap & proposed POC playbook — BluePeak (tech notes + blocker)

Tessa — quick technical read and mitigations for Samir's asks.

Summary: VPC/private deployment is supported via our Redwood Private (VPC peering / dedicated host) offering. For a 3-week POC we can do a temporary VPC deployment in customer-managed VLAN with KMS integration — timeline depends on network approvals but typically 5-8 business days for the basic setup.

Required access (minimal):
- Customer firewall: allow outbound to 34.200.11.9/32 (redwood ingress) and a small egress range for upgrades (we'll provide exact CIDRs).
- Ports: 443 for TLS (API), 22 only if you want SSH debug access (opt-in).

Audit artifacts we can provide: SOC2 Type II summary, control mappings, redacted pen-test report, and flow logs for the POC window. I attached a checklist for the security questionnaire.

Immediate technical risk: we've identified a compatibility bug (internal tracking #INF-4273) in our on-prem model connector that affects models with custom tokenizer offsets — this can manifest as tokenization mismatches and skewed evaluation metrics. Severity: P2 for this use-case (affects accuracy numbers on a subset of ticket text).

Mitigation options:
- Workaround A (fast): pre-tokenize customer sample on a Redwood-provided container with a patched tokenizer shim. Estimated effort: 1 engineering day.
- Workaround B (medium): use a validated model variant that bypasses the custom tokenizer path (reduces latency by ~5-8ms but may require small quality retune).
- Long-term: engineering fix scheduled in sprint 6 (ETA 3 weeks).

Escalation path if the workaround is insufficient:
1) SE in the POC: Hannah Schmitt (owner)
2) Solutions Eng lead: Rajiv Menon (on-call for Redwood Private)
3) Eng on-call: pager escalation (if code fix needed)

I recommend we propose Workaround A so BluePeak can proceed with the timeline; that gives them private deployment + actionable accuracy numbers while we push the code fix.

I'll draft a one-page tech note and the tokenization shim container; Tessa — can you confirm Samir is OK with the temporary shim approach?

-Hannah
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: security_questionnaire_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@bluepeak.com>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@bluepeak.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Feb 2027 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC playbook — BluePeak (kickoff timing + docs)

Samir / Elena —

Thanks for the quick notes. We can shift the kickoff to Mar 3 to accommodate your sample timing. Per Hannah, Redwood Private (VPC mode) is supported and we can provide SOC2 artifacts and KMS integration details during the kickoff.

Given the tokenization compatibility risk Hannah flagged (INF-4273), our recommended path is:
- Implement Workaround A (tokenizer shim) during Week 0 so you can run baseline comparisons in Week 1. That requires ~1 dev day from our side and we can have the shim container ready for Mar 3.

Proposed next steps (to lock schedule):
- You confirm Mar 3 kickoff (30 min)
- BluePeak accepts temporary tokenization shim (yes/no)
- BluePeak share 500-ticket sample to secure SFTP by Mar 3 (instructions attached)

I’ve attached the POC playbook and a short success-matrix spreadsheet. I’ll send a calendar invite for Mar 3, 10:00 AM PT.

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.com/deals/RDW-2027-1189
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_poc-bluepeak

If you approve the shim approach I’ll move Hannah to owner for the technical onboarding and we’ll schedule the SE runbook.

Best,
Tessa

Date: Mon, 28 Feb 2027 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: quick escalation note — BluePeak blocker and negotiation posture

Aditya / Marissa —

Quick heads up before kickoff: BluePeak requires VPC and has a hard security gating condition. Hannah found a P2-level compatibility bug (INF-4273) that impacts tokenization for certain ticket text. We plan to deliver the tokenizer shim as a short-term mitigation (1 eng day) to keep the POC on the Mar 3 start.

Risks to the deal: if we push a longer timeline or require a full code fix before POC, BluePeak may delay and go to a competitor. Zero friction path is to accept the shim for the POC and commit to the formal fix within 3 weeks.

Recommendation for negotiation if they push back:
- Offer 30% credit on the first month of Dedicated if BluePeak converts within 60 days (to offset engineering time).
- Escalation path: SE (Hannah) -> Solutions Eng lead (Rajiv) -> Eng on-call (pager).

Can you advise on approval for the credit/discount floor? If you want, I can frame this as a limited POC concession to secure the kickoff.

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Tessa — thanks. We accept the tokenizer shim for POC and confirm Mar 3, 10:00 AM PT kickoff. Samir and Elena will upload the 500-ticket sample to the SFTP by EOD Mar 3. Please include SOC2 snapshot and KMS integration steps in the kickoff packet.

Samir
